newsitem.title: FRANCE: Spanish prince meets French president.
newsitem.headline: Spanish prince meets French president.

text.p: Crown Prince Felipe of Spain and President Jacques Chirac of France discussed European and other international issues when the prince met Chirac at the Elysee presidential palace in Paris on Wednesday, officials said.
Chirac told the 28-year-old prince that France appreciated his visit and asked him to transmit his best wishes to his father King Juan Carlos, the officials said.
The prince, who was accompanied by Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes, later flew to Toulouse, in southwest France.
